hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps entirely through paired Euler Finance vaults, bypassing Uniswap's concentrated liquidity. Each pool is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy; beforeSwap computes quotes via a custom bonding curve, moves tokens through Euler vaults, and verifies the curve invariant before returning a BeforeSwapDelta.
